items.title: Jolt Used to Be Called Surge
items.stat_value: Jolt began as Surge, The Demogorgon's unique perk — renamed and made general when the Stranger Things license lapsed.

items.title: Average Kill Rate: ~58.5%
items.stat_value: Killers eliminate about 58.5% of survivors on average, per a BHVR developer update (data through Feb 2024).

items.title: Most Played Survivor: Claudette Morel
items.stat_value: Claudette Morel is the most-played survivor, followed by Meg Thomas and Feng Min, per a BHVR stats reveal.

items.title: Deadliest Killers by Kill Rate
items.stat_value: Skull Merchant, The Plague, and Sadako top the kill-rate leaderboard per community-tracked match data (NightLight.gg).
